nodes.label: Verified native audio readiness
nodes.rationale: Video restart alone does not establish sound. Readiness also requires selected expected audio, decoder parameters and active output while preserving intentional mute/volume.

nodes.label: Disposable cache boundary
nodes.rationale: Internal cache can be evicted and full-source caching consumes additional bandwidth; explicit Downloads provide intentional permanent storage.

nodes.label: Pinned cache file leases
nodes.rationale: Clearing retires entries immediately but delays byte deletion until the native player closes pinned files; eviction targets older unpinned entries.

nodes.label: Current-load stale-work guard
nodes.rationale: New load identities prevent old extraction, native entry events and recovery attempts from committing to a newer selection.

nodes.label: Local-first source selection
nodes.rationale: Try completed downloads, then validated internal components, then online extraction; explicit quality changes may bypass a lower-quality local source.

nodes.label: FFprobe publication gate
nodes.rationale: Partial files cannot become reusable offline entries until expected tracks and complete duration are validated.

nodes.label: Stable media identity
nodes.rationale: Reusable local media must survive expiring extraction URLs; persisted indexes omit signed URLs, headers and cookies.

nodes.label: Explicit verification limits
nodes.rationale: Historical tests do not certify every DPI, disk-full, expiry, codec or provider-policy case; installer compilation is distinguished from installation.

nodes.label: Historical 0.1.5 ASS/Lua controls
nodes.description: Historical physical-pixel ASS fades and native translucent settings menus. Viewsical 0.1.6 replaced these controls with shared React controls; this section does not describe the current renderer.

nodes.label: mpv volume-gain
nodes.description: Per-file dB gain remains separate from user volume, mute, speed, position and pause intent; no re-encoding or filter-chain rebuild.

nodes.label: Viewsical yt-dlp loudness plugin
nodes.description: Pinned yt-dlp 2026.10.26 extractor hook reads playerConfig.audioConfig.loudnessDb only when the response video ID matches the requested item. Context-local scope handles reuse, nesting, concurrency and exceptions. Only the application-owned plugin directory is enabled.

nodes.label: MediaItem.youtubeLoudnessDb metadata
nodes.description: Rust revalidates optional loudness metadata and preserves only the stable numeric value in cache/download records for offline gain; legacy records use neutral gain and downloaded bytes remain unchanged.

nodes.label: Attenuation-only loudness normalization
nodes.rationale: For finite loudness metadata in [-100,100] dB, enabled playback applies clamp(-loudness_db,-20,0) dB. No boost avoids adding clipping without a measured peak or limiter; missing/invalid metadata and disabled normalization use 0 dB. This is not waveform analysis or a guaranteed LUFS target.

nodes.label: Guarded normalization source commits
nodes.rationale: Explicit volume-gain file options reset missing metadata to zero. Selection/load/session guards reject stale results; settings changes serialize with source commits, and file-loaded rechecks settings to cover changes during opening.

nodes.label: Independent main-window maximization state
nodes.rationale: SQLite ui_state restores maximized/restored state before showing the window. Fullscreen, minimized and hidden states, frontend settings and account changes cannot replace that normal-window choice.

nodes.label: Native clipping and navigation verification
nodes.description: Four frontend geometry tests, two Rust clipping tests, regressions, native region diagnostics and screenshot inspection verify identical regions, unchanged video dimensions/load ID and restoration without reload. Native inspection used 125% Windows scale; browser layouts cover 100%,125%,150%,200% density.

nodes.label: Search submit and Back to top controls
nodes.description: Separate accessible 46px circular search submit; Home remains in sidebar and logo. Home and individual playlists show Back to top after 320px, respect reduced motion, focus the heading, retain loaded pages and avoid floating/bottom players.
nodes.norm_label: search submit and back to top controls

nodes.label: Restricted overlay capability boundary
nodes.rationale: The overlay uses scoped playback commands, revisioned snapshots and load IDs. Cookies and temporary media URLs stay in native code.

nodes.label: Shared native visible clipping
nodes.rationale: playerViewport.ts sends the original physical rectangle and actual header bottom; player_geometry::visible_clip intersects it with the available client viewport. Both mpv and controls receive the same rounded clipped region, preserving video size, playback position and load while scrolling. Fully offscreen, audio-only, docked and blocked surfaces hide; fullscreen uses the entire client viewport.

nodes.label: Historical recommendation to retain Tauri
nodes.rationale: Retain Tauri for the existing Windows app unless a measured prototype shows a specific advantage or TypeScript backend maintenance is a priority. Electron may simplify JavaScript/session integration and provide controlled Chromium, while native playback composition, extraction failures and embedded Google sign-in remain separate problems.

nodes.label: Historical shell migration proposal
nodes.rationale: A shell migration could retain Rust media logic as a service after decoupling AppHandle, events, paths and native window ownership. Preserve SQLite/cache data and plan authentication migration; yt-dlp, Deno, FFmpeg, FFprobe and mpv remain dependencies when only the shell changes.
